description: Work with layer masks (Layer > Layer Mask and the Layers panel): add a mask (Reveal All, Hide All, Reveal Selection or Hide Selection), apply it to the pixels, delete it, disable or enable it, link or unlink it from the layer, invert it, target the mask or the layer content for editing, load the mask as a selection, or copy or move it to another layer

invert.description: load_selection: select the hidden area instead

reveal.description: add: what the new mask shows. Default reveal_selection when there is a selection, otherwise reveal_all

showAlone.description: target_mask: show the mask by itself in the document window

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

to.description: copy_to, move_to: id of the layer that receives the mask; it must not have one

name: edit_layer_mask
title: Edit Layer Mask
